value.rationale: For the natural 12-conic Hesse/Chilean family, the residue characteristic excluded in foundational literature is a substantial arithmetic boundary: nine components coalesce, the reduced degree drops to eight, and the singularities reorganize into precisely three nodes plus three nonordinary triple contacts of pairwise multiplicity (3,2,2). This complete parameter-uniform special-fibre classification and exact delta accounting are structurally meaningful, not an arbitrary finite sample or routine count. Its exact rational support over all 3-power fields is a natural consequence rather than the sole justification of value.
